_source: Evil Mode rework (DOMINION) slice D11, the Hero and the Heroic Legendaries. Design: /mnt/project-files/plans/evil-mode-rework/ Part 4 sections 7-8 (the Hero, Threat stages, the final stand; Heroic Legendaries), Part 9 A8-A9 (the Hero's reason, adapting, Disillusion), Part 0 section 6.1 Q1 (grown-up Heroes) and Q5 (your rival plays the Hero), lists/outside-interactions.md section G (O166-O185, all twenty). Teams, allies, counters, encounter text and every number are this slice's own writing; none are playtested.

archetypes.name: Protector
archetypes.taunt: Nobody gets hurt while I'm here.

archetypes.name: Champion-Chaser
archetypes.taunt: You're one more trainer between me and the top.

archetypes.name: Strategist
archetypes.taunt: I've read every move you've made. You repeat yourself.

archetypes.name: Bitter Challenger
archetypes.taunt: I used to be like you. Then I grew up.

archetypes.name: Enthusiast
archetypes.taunt: A real villain! This is going to be a great battle!

archetypes.name: Idealist
archetypes.taunt: Pokémon deserve better than you. So do people.

archetypes.name: Underdog
archetypes.taunt: Everyone says I can't beat you. Everyone's been wrong before.

stages.does: Shows up at one of your jobs a week and battles you for it.
Hunts your crew on their tasks; frees Pokémon from your stores.
Breaks up one of your Rackets a week.
Recruits Gym Leaders, the Champion and a Legendary; raids your HQ.

reasons.text: get the stolen Pokémon back to their trainers
reasons.wrong: The trainer the Hero was protecting had been selling their own Pokémon on the side.
The shopkeeper the Hero was protecting had been skimming from the whole street.
The Leader the Hero wanted back had been taking bribes for years.

reasons.text: find out why criminals are helping people

reasons.wrong: The research the Hero wanted back was weapons work.

reasons.text: stop every criminal team, not just one
find out what you really want

reasons.wrong: The 'travellers' the Hero was guarding were smugglers.

adapt.line: The Hero has been beating {type} specialists all week.

stand.joinLine: I'll fight anyone you point me at. Not people. Teams.

rows.title: The Hero is spotted in town
rows.text: {hero} is walking down {district}'s main street, nodding at shopkeepers like they own the place.

choices.label: Avoid
choices.line: You step into a doorway until {hero} has passed.

choices.label: Watch
choices.line: You trail {hero} for an hour. You know where they'll be for the next two days.

choices.label: Challenge
choices.line: You step out and call {hero}'s name. A battle, here, in the street: fixed rules, no stakes.

rows.title: The Hero helps townsfolk
rows.text: {hero} is carrying an old man's shopping across {district}. People are clapping.

choices.label: Cheer
choices.line: You clap too. Nobody believes you mean it.

choices.label: Disrupt
choices.line: Your people knock the bags out of their arms. The crowd goes quiet and afraid.

rows.title: The Hero's Pokémon is injured
rows.text: {hero}'s partner is limping outside the closed Pokémon Center in {district}. They look lost.

choices.label: Help
choices.line: You hand over a Potion without a word. {hero} stares at you for a long time.

choices.label: Ignore
choices.line: You walk past. You don't look back.

rows.title: The Hero asks directions
rows.text: {hero} doesn't recognise you in the crowd and asks the way to the next Gym.

choices.label: Lie
choices.line: You send {hero} the long way round, through the marsh. That's a day gone.

choices.label: Tell
choices.line: You point the right way. Old habits.

choices.label: Offer help
choices.line: You walk {hero} there yourself. Halfway, they realise who you are, and say nothing.

rows.title: A letter from the Hero
rows.text: A letter under the warehouse door, in careful handwriting: "I know what you are. I want to know why."

choices.label: Reply
choices.line: You write back the truth, and some proof.

choices.label: Burn
choices.line: You burn it in front of the crew. They cheer.

choices.label: Show the town
choices.line: You pin it up in the square with a joke under it.

rows.title: The Hero's mentor speaks to you
rows.text: {mentor} finds you on a bench in {district}. "I taught that trainer everything. Don't make them use it on you."

choices.label: Listen
choices.line: You let the old man talk. Some of it even stays with you.

choices.label: Taunt
choices.line: "Tell your student I'm waiting." Word gets back fast.

rows.title: Another rival challenges the Hero
rows.text: An Ace Trainer has stopped {hero} on the road out of {district}. A crowd gathers.

choices.label: Watch
choices.line: You watch every move. Now you know {hero}'s team by heart.

choices.label: Interfere
choices.line: Your Grunt throws a Smoke Ball into the battle. {hero} loses the day sorting it out.

rows.title: The Hero fights a rival Admin
rows.text: {hero} has cornered an Admin of {rival} behind the Game Corner.

choices.label: Help the Hero
choices.line: You send your Grunts in on {hero}'s side. {hero} doesn't know what to make of it.

choices.label: Help the Admin
choices.line: You back the Admin. {hero} sees exactly who you are.

choices.label: Stay out
choices.line: Let them tire each other out.

rows.title: A kid asks the Hero to sign a hat
rows.text: A kid in {district} holds out a cap and a marker. {hero} kneels down to sign it.

choices.label: Watch
choices.line: You watch from across the street. For a second you remember wanting that.

choices.label: Hide
choices.line: You pull your collar up and keep walking.

rows.title: The Hero visits a Gym
rows.text: {hero} walks into the {district} Gym with a fresh bag of Potions.

choices.label: Follow
choices.line: You watch the whole match from the stands. You learn their next two stops.

choices.label: Stop
choices.line: Your people block the Gym doors. {hero} has to come back tomorrow.

rows.title: A challenge: the Hero's team against yours
rows.text: {hero} sends word: "Fixed rules. No stakes. Just us."

choices.label: Accept
choices.line: You meet at the edge of {district} at noon.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.line: You don't answer. Let them wonder.

rows.title: The Hero leaves a mark on a bridge
rows.text: Someone has painted {hero}'s badge on the bridge into {district}, right over your crew's mark.

choices.label: Replace
choices.line: You paint over it, bigger.

choices.label: Keep
choices.line: You leave it. The town notices you left it.

rows.title: The Hero's sidekick speaks to you
rows.text: {sidekick} who follows {hero} everywhere plants their feet in front of you: "Battle me!"

choices.label: Battle
choices.line: You battle the kid. Fair and square, nothing else.

rows.title: The Hero saves a kidnapped Pokémon
rows.text: {hero} has found a Pokémon in a cage behind a {district} warehouse and is picking the lock.

choices.label: Interrupt
choices.line: Your Grunts chase them off. The cage goes back in the van.

choices.label: Applaud
choices.line: You clap slowly from the shadows. {hero} doesn't know whether to thank you.

rows.title: The Hero faces the bounty hunters you hired
rows.text: The hunters you paid have {hero} pinned down outside {district}.

choices.label: Reinforce
choices.line: You pay for two more. {hero} loses two days getting out.

choices.label: Pull back
choices.line: You call them off. Not like this.

rows.title: The Hero's badge count rises
rows.text: {hero} has won another badge. That's {badges} now.

choices.label: Plan around it
choices.line: You mark the next Gym on the map. You'll know where {hero} is going.

rows.title: The Hero is cornered by Grunts
rows.text: Three of your Grunts have {hero} backed against a fence in {district}, without your orders.

choices.label: Join the Grunts
choices.line: You step in beside them. {hero} has to fight their way out.

choices.label: Save them
choices.line: You send the Grunts home. {hero} walks past you very slowly.

rows.title: The Hero's family calls
rows.text: {parent} rings the warehouse phone. "I know my child is chasing you. I want you to know they're not alone."

choices.label: Talk
choices.line: You talk for twenty minutes. You hang up before you say too much.

choices.label: Mock
choices.line: You laugh down the phone. The story is all over town by night.

rows.title: The Hero stands on your doorstep
rows.text: Late. A knock at the warehouse. {hero} is on the doorstep, alone.

choices.label: Fight
choices.line: You step outside. The crew watches from the windows.

choices.label: Talk
choices.line: You talk until the street lamps go off. {hero} tells you why they started.

choices.label: Hide
choices.line: You kill the lights and wait until they leave.

rows.title: The Hero's gift to a stranger
rows.text: {hero} hands a stranger in {district} something small and shiny, then walks on.

choices.label: Learn
choices.line: You ask the stranger. It's a lucky charm from {hero}'s first journey. You learn where they're headed.

choices.label: Steal
choices.line: You take it off the stranger before nightfall. {hero} will hear about this.

lines.met: You've seen the Hero up close: {hero}.
lines.reason: {hero} has a reason to fight you now: {reason}.
lines.foilWon: {hero} goes down. The job goes on.
lines.foilLost: {hero} beat you. The job is off.
lines.run: You run. The job is lost. Heat +{heat}.
lines.smokeClean: Smoke fills the street. By the time it clears, you're gone.
lines.smokeFail: The smoke clears too soon. {hero} is right there.
lines.hunt: {hero} found {name} on the job. {name} is hurt for {days} days.
lines.free: {hero} broke into your stores and set {n} Pokémon free.
lines.racket: {hero} broke up your Racket at {target}. The owner is free of you.
lines.noRacket: {hero} went looking for your Rackets and found none.
lines.raid: {hero} is at the warehouse door with {n} allies.
lines.raidLost: {hero} cleaned out the warehouse: ₽{take} gone, {n} Pokémon set free.
lines.wreck: {legend} tore through {target}. That Racket is gone.
lines.scatter: {legend} swept over {district}. Your Control there fell by {n}.
lines.loose: {legend} broke open your stores. {n} Pokémon flew free.
lines.calm: {legend} circled {over} and left your holdings alone.
lines.legendWon: {legend} is driven off. It won't be back for {weeks} weeks.
lines.legendNoCatch: It won't be caught. It is defending this region.
lines.legendDay: Fighting a Legendary takes a Day action.
lines.legendNone: No Legendary is out there right now.
lines.standWon: You beat {hero} at full strength. The region is yours. Now decide what happens to them.
lines.standLost: {hero} beat you. {n} districts slip back to Contested; {hero} will be back in {days} days.
lines.leave: {hero} walks away with nothing. People will talk about this for years.
lines.joined: {hero} joins your crew as an Executive: "{line}"
lines.refused: {hero} refuses, and leaves with their head up.
lines.notMet: You haven't met the Hero yet.
lines.notHere: The Hero isn't in {district}. They're in {at}.
lines.notStage: The Hero isn't hunting you hard enough for a duel yet (Threat 45).
lines.track: {name} tracked {hero}: the route is known {n} days ahead.
lines.counter: {name}'s counter-story ran. {hero}'s name loses some shine.
lines.hunt3: {name} set a trap on {hero}'s road. They lose a day.
lines.hunt5: {name} has {hero} cornered: they must duel you, whatever their Threat.
lines.shame: {hero} was laughed at in {district}. Their nerve slips.
lines.ambush: {hero} is stuck on the road for {n} days.
lines.item: You lifted {hero}'s {item}. They'll waste a day looking for it.
lines.friendHint: {hero}'s friend tells you where they're headed next.
lines.challenge: No stakes: you shake hands and go your ways.
